frame.units: metres; viewer world = terrain.glb frame (three.js, Y up)
frame.datum_source: measured: mode of (ground elevation - terrain.glb y), 89% of ground vertices within 0.3 m
frame.uv: u = x/(gsd*(W-1)), v = 1 + z/(gsd*(H-1)) into scene texture_file

sources.h: Meta/WRI Global Canopy Height v2 (dinov3_global_chm_v2_ml3, 1.194 m, EPSG:3857), registered to scene texture by shift (-0.12, +0.12) m (x, image-down), phase-corr response 0.110
sources.ground: DTM from the DSM: p10 per 9.6 m block of pixels outside buildings, canopy (v1/v2 >= 1 m) and green texture; nearest-filled, smoothed
sources.mask: canopy height >= 1.5 m (+2 px), texture luminance < 150, outside building footprints + lean-displaced roofs, not bright-grey

crown_shape: INFERRED: marker watershed of a 1.2 m canopy-height product; ellipse = 2-sigma of crown pixels

fields.y: ground elevation under the centroid, world y (m) -- trunk base
fields.h: tree height above ground (m), canopy-height product peak in crown
fields.hd: DSM - ground at the crown's highest pixel (m): the built scene's surface
fields.yt: rendered terrain.glb surface y at the centroid (m; includes its canopy bump)
fields.ra: ellipse semi-major axis (m), 2*sqrt(lambda1) of crown pixel covariance
fields.rot: three.js rotation.y (rad) turning local +X onto the major axis
fields.Rd: dark quartile (lowest-luminance 25% of crown pixels) mean, sRGB
